question.text: There is a small air bubble at the centre of a solid glass sphere of radius $r$ and refractive index $\mu .$ What will be the apparent distance of the bubble from the centre of the sphere, when viewed from outside?

solution.text: ' As the object is at centre of the sphere. $\therefore$ All rays will fall normally on surface, hence they do not deflect. Thus, a virtual image is formed at the centre $O$. $\therefore$ Apparent depth $=$ Real depth
